messages:
anya: Heads-up — I want to finalize hero headlines + subheads for the three landing pages tonight (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Can we do quick copy alignments here? Trying to keep messaging consistent: speed, predictable cost, and control.

mike: on it. paste the current live variants?

anya: Current live (rough):
```
Hosted API
Headline: Start building with our API in minutes
Subhead: Low-friction access to curated models, scaling automatically as you grow.

Dedicated
Headline: Dedicated GPU capacity for production workloads
Subhead: Predictable throughput and enterprise isolation.

Private
Headline: Private deployment inside your network
Subhead: Full control, compliance, and on-prem performance.
```

sophia: Thanks — my immediate thought: tighten verbs and lead with benefit. E.g. Hosted: "Ship features fast" not "Start building". More active.

jared: Also add a single SEO phrase per hero that targets infra buyers: "low-latency inference" or "cost-efficient inference". We should avoid repeating "performance" across all three.

olivia: CTA alignment: if Hosted uses "Get API key", Dedicated should be "Request dedicated capacity" and Private "Request private deployment" — however we'd like to unify with single verb where possible for analytics. Maybe use "Get started" across all and add secondary CTAs for sales flows.

mike: Proposed compact options (one-line heroes + one-line subheads):
```
Hosted API
Headline A: Ship LLM features fast
Subhead A: Instant API access to vetted models — scale on demand with predictable pricing.

Dedicated
Headline A: Predictable capacity for production
Subhead A: Reserved GPU pools with SLA-backed latency and throughput.

Private
Headline A: Inference under your control
Subhead A: VPC-ready or on-prem deployment with enterprise key management and audit logs.
```

anya: Love the terser language. A few edits: Hosted subhead — remove "vetted" (sounds vague) and swap "predictable pricing" -> "predictable unit cost". Dedicated subhead — call out "autoscale policies" as a benefit. Private subhead — move "on-prem" earlier: "On-prem or VPC deployment" sounds clearer.

sophia: Small nit: "unit cost" might confuse non-finance folks. What about "predictable per-token cost"? It's explicit and ties to product.

jared: For SEO I'd suggest append a short phrase after the subhead for each: e.g. "— low-latency inference" but keep it visually hidden for users (aria) or in meta tags. Don't stuff the hero itself.

olivia: A/B test plan: variant 1 uses action verbs (Ship / Predictable / Inference under your control), variant 2 uses outcome-focused (Build faster / Save on inference / Secure private inference). We track signup conversion and demo requests. UTM: marketing.hero_test.

anya: Action items:
- Mike: produce final hero + subhead + 2 CTAs per page for staging by 5pm (UTC).
- Sophia: draft meta title + description with SEO anchor phrases for each page.
- Jared: confirm target keywords and share recommended meta lines.
- Olivia: set up A/B test in Optimizely and create tracking plan.
- marketing-bot: create PR to the copy repo with branch "hero/three-mode-197250" and add reviewers @anya @mike.

mike: Will do. Quick question — for Dedicated, do we mention "monthly commitments" in hero or leave to pricing page?

anya: Leave commitments to pricing/feature panels. Hero should sell the core promise: predictable capacity + SLA. Add a small secondary line in the features band about commitments.

marketing-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/copy/compare/hero/three-mode-197250 • reviewers: anya, mike • status: open :tada:

olivia: I pushed an Optimizely skeleton and added events for hero_click, secondary_cta, and demo_request. Tagging product analytics to verify schemas.

sophia: I'll drop meta titles by 3pm. Example for Hosted: "Hosted API — Start LLM features fast | Redwood Inference" and meta desc: "Instant API access to low-latency inference with predictable per-token cost. Try the Hosted API."

jared: Uploaded target keyword doc (link in threads) — main keywords: "low-latency inference", "dedicated gpu inference", "private LLM deployment".

anya: Great work team. If copy + meta + tracking are ready by EOD we can push to staging tomorrow morning and run the A/B test for 2 weeks. Quick thumbs if you're aligned. :thumbsup:
